# 文档

- [概览](/docs): G6Lite — 基于 WebGL 的高性能图可视化与分析引擎
- [用 AI 构建 G6Lite 图](/docs/ai): 使用 G6Lite Skill、本地 AI Agent 与 Sive 创建、排查和优化关系图
- 快速开始
  - [安装与第一个图](/docs/getting-started/quick-start): 安装 G6Lite，准备容器，并渲染第一个可交互图
  - [在 React 中使用](/docs/getting-started/react): 用 useRef 和 useEffect 在 React 组件中挂载 G6Lite
- 核心概念
  - [G6Lite 是什么](/docs/concepts/overview): G6Lite 的定位、适用场景和与 G6 v5 的关系
  - [技术架构](/docs/concepts/architecture): G6Lite 的公开 API、数据运行时、布局、交互、WebGL 渲染与浏览器平台分层
  - [Graph 生命周期](/docs/concepts/graph-lifecycle): 从创建 Graph 到 render、更新、重新布局和销毁
  - [数据模型](/docs/concepts/data-model): GraphData、节点、边、Combo、业务字段和状态的组织方式
- 配置指南
  - [数据](/docs/guides/data): G6Lite 的图数据格式与 Graph 顶层配置项
  - [节点](/docs/guides/node): 节点类型、样式函数、状态样式和性能建议
  - [边](/docs/guides/edge): 边类型、箭头、标签、状态样式和平行边
  - [标签与图标](/docs/guides/label): 节点标签、边标签和节点图标配置
  - [Combo](/docs/guides/combo): 节点分组容器的声明、样式、折叠展开和整体拖拽
  - [主题](/docs/guides/theme): 使用 light / dark 主题并覆盖 token
  - [布局配置](/docs/guides/layout): 内置布局类型、选型建议、常用参数与 Worker 支持
  - [交互配置](/docs/guides/interactions): 内置 behaviors、启用方式和常用交互组合
  - [自定义 Behavior](/docs/guides/custom-behavior): 使用类型安全的 options、GraphEventMap 和 extensionFactory 编写可复用交互扩展
  - [事件](/docs/guides/events): 使用 GraphEventMap 和 graph.on、graph.off、graph.once 监听公开事件
  - [Tooltip 配置](/docs/guides/tooltip): 使用内置 tooltip behavior 展示节点和边信息
  - [平行边与自环处理](/docs/guides/parallel-edges): 处理多条同源同目标边和自环边的展示
  - [扩展体系](/docs/guides/extensions): 通过配置、函数式映射和公开扩展 API 完成受控业务定制
  - [自定义节点](/docs/guides/custom-node): 使用统一 register 和函数式 NodeExtension 扩展节点表现形式
  - [自定义 Label Renderer](/docs/guides/custom-label-renderer): 自定义节点和边的 Label 内容，并复用定位、旋转、碰撞与调度能力
- API 参考
  - [API 参考](/docs/api): 由 TypeDoc 从 src/index.ts 的公共 API 类型自动生成
- 示例
  - [图表示例](/docs/examples): 按 G6Lite 公开能力分类浏览并直接运行官网示例
  - [最简关系图](/docs/examples/basic): 使用最少配置渲染一个可缩放、可拖拽的关系图
  - [默认主题与交互状态](/docs/examples/default-theme): 并排检查 light、dark 预设主题和节点、边默认状态
  - [节点与边增删改](/docs/examples/data-mutations): 集中演示节点和边的单个、批量新增、更新和删除
  - [查询、批量状态与可见性](/docs/examples/queries-and-states): 验证元素、邻接、状态查询，以及批量状态和可见性控制
  - [全量替换数据](/docs/examples/set-data): 用 setData 替换整图数据，并在替换后切换布局。
  - [搜索并聚焦](/docs/examples/search-focus): 按名称搜索节点，高亮匹配项并把视口移过去。
  - [节点数据映射样式](/docs/examples/node-style): 按业务字段动态设置节点颜色、尺寸和高亮交互
  - [图形类型](/docs/examples/shapes): 并排查看圆形和矩形节点。
  - [节点边框与圆角](/docs/examples/node-border): 调整描边、线宽和矩形圆角。
  - [边与箭头方向](/docs/examples/edge-arrows): 比较无箭头、单向、双向和粗边箭头
  - [边类型](/docs/examples/edge-types): 展示直线、虚线、弧线和曲线。
  - [边颜色](/docs/examples/edge-colors): 按业务分类给边映射颜色。
  - [边状态与权重](/docs/examples/edge-states): 用权重映射边宽，并查看边的状态样式。
  - [细边交互热区](/docs/examples/edge-hit-area): 保持细线外观，同时扩大直线、曲线和自环的拾取范围。
  - [平行边与反向边](/docs/examples/parallel-edges): 自动错开同源同目标的多条边、反向边和单边
  - [自环边](/docs/examples/edge-loops): 展示一个节点上的单条和多层嵌套自环。
  - [标签位置与图标](/docs/examples/labels): 展示节点标签、边标签、图标，并在运行时切换位置。
  - [标签渲染策略](/docs/examples/label-rendering-options): 对比固定字号、低缩放持续绘制和关闭碰撞隐藏。
  - [折线与正交路由](/docs/examples/polyline-routing): 用圆角正交折线连接从左到右的流程节点。
  - [Combo 分组容器](/docs/examples/combo): 展示嵌套分组、折叠展开、运行时归组和数据导出
  - [常用布局切换](/docs/examples/layouts): 在同一份数据上切换 circular、force、grid 和 dagre
  - [更多内置布局](/docs/examples/layout-gallery): 比较 radial、concentric、ForceAtlas2、fruchterman、MDS 和 random
  - [流程图](/docs/examples/flowchart): 用层级布局和折线边绘制决策流程。
  - [缩进树](/docs/examples/indented-tree): 用缩进布局展示目录结构。
  - [Worker 布局](/docs/examples/layout-worker): 把力导向计算放到 Web Worker，避免挡住主线程。
  - [辐射树](/docs/examples/radial-tree): 用辐射布局把一棵主题树铺在中心节点周围。
  - [调用链](/docs/examples/dependency-graph): 用从左到右的层级布局展示服务之间的调用关系。
  - [人物关系网络](/docs/examples/relationship): 使用力导布局和关系标签展示人物关联
  - [组织架构图](/docs/examples/org-chart): 使用层级布局展示组织与团队关系
  - [思维导图](/docs/examples/mindmap): 围绕中心主题展开双向知识分支
  - [鱼骨图](/docs/examples/fishbone): 将问题、分类与原因组织为鱼骨归因结构
  - [Tooltip 浮层](/docs/examples/tooltip): 悬停节点或边时展示自定义业务信息
  - [悬停高亮](/docs/examples/hover): 悬停节点或边时高亮关联元素，并淡化其余元素。
  - [一度邻居高亮](/docs/examples/neighbor-highlight): 悬停节点高亮邻居和连边，悬停边高亮两端节点。
  - [点选、框选与拉索选择](/docs/examples/selection-behaviors): 在同一示例中比较 click、brush 和 lasso 选择行为
  - [拖拽节点与 Combo](/docs/examples/drag-node): 拖拽单个节点，或拖拽 Combo 背景带动其中的节点。
  - [拖拽边端点](/docs/examples/drag-edge): 把边的端点拖到另一个节点上，完成重新连线。
  - [事件面板](/docs/examples/event-log): 点击、拖拽和选择节点时，查看 Graph 发出的公开事件。
  - [右键菜单](/docs/examples/context-menu): 在节点上打开右键菜单，执行聚焦或高亮。
  - [视口与坐标转换](/docs/examples/viewport-controls): 验证 camera、fit、zoom、focus、resize 和屏幕/图坐标互转
  - [缩放范围与灵敏度](/docs/examples/zoom-options): 把滚轮缩放限制在指定灵敏度和最小、最大比例之间。
  - [扩展系统综合示例](/docs/examples/extension-system): 组合验证 decoration、edge、layout、transform、behavior 和 plugin 扩展
  - [呼吸节点](/docs/examples/breathing-node): 用自定义节点动画表现选中和高亮状态。
  - [自定义标签渲染](/docs/examples/custom-label-renderer): 节点和边共用一个自定义 Label Renderer。
  - [自定义节点与显式边 ID](/docs/examples/custom-node-extension): 注册自定义节点，并使用显式边 ID 与 Combo 状态。
  - [注册自定义 Behavior](/docs/examples/custom-behavior): 注册一个 Behavior：点击节点时选中它，点击画布时清除。
  - [自定义布局](/docs/examples/custom-layout): 注册一个把节点排成两行的布局扩展。
  - [节点徽章](/docs/examples/decoration-badges): 在节点边界堆叠计数、状态和文本徽章。
  - [AI Papers 大规模关系图](/docs/examples/real-dataset): 使用真实论文引用网络验证大图渲染和交互链路
  - [200 节点](/docs/examples/large): 用 200 个节点快速查看中等规模图的渲染和交互。
  - [5000 节点与标签](/docs/examples/large-labeled): 在 5000 个节点上绘制 Canvas 标签。
- 技术指标
  - [性能指标](/docs/metrics/performance): G6Lite 的可复现 Benchmark 入口、指标口径、环境记录与结果使用边界
  - [性能调优](/docs/metrics/performance-tuning): 大图首屏、交互、标签、状态与布局的优化建议和度量方法
  - [包体积](/docs/metrics/bundle-size): G6Lite 的 size-limit 测量口径、120 kB brotli 预算与复现方法
- 兼容性
  - [兼容性总览](/docs/compatibility): 浏览器、运行环境、公开 API 稳定性与 G6 v5 迁移边界
  - [浏览器与运行环境](/docs/compatibility/browser): G6Lite 的 WebGL 支持矩阵、最低浏览器版本与已知问题
  - [API 稳定性与发布边界](/docs/compatibility/api-stability): G6Lite 的公开入口、稳定能力、弃用兼容层与实验性能力说明
  - [常用图库能力对比](/docs/compatibility/library-comparison): 按渲染、布局、元素、交互、扩展、算法和运行环境对比 G6Lite、G6 v5、sigma.js 与 Cytoscape.js
  - [从 G6 v5 迁移](/docs/compatibility/g6-v5-migration): 按配置、数据、Behavior、事件、Graph API 和扩展体系迁移到 G6Lite
- [常见问题](/docs/faq): G6Lite 的选型、性能、兼容性、SSR、TypeScript 与 Combo 高频问题
- [更新日志](/docs/changelog): G6Lite 的版本与变更记录

# Documentation

- [Overview](/en/docs): G6Lite documentation for getting started, configuration, API, examples, metrics, and compatibility
- [Build G6Lite graphs with AI](/en/docs/ai): Use the G6Lite Skill, local AI agents, and Sive to create, troubleshoot, and optimize graph visualizations
- Quick start
  - [Install and render your first graph](/en/docs/getting-started/quick-start): Install G6Lite, prepare a sized container, and render an interactive graph
  - [Use G6Lite with React](/en/docs/getting-started/react): Mount and clean up a Graph instance with useRef and useEffect
- Core concepts
  - [What is G6Lite?](/en/docs/concepts/overview): Positioning, suitable workloads, and the relationship between G6Lite and G6 v5
  - [Technical architecture](/en/docs/concepts/architecture): Layers for G6Lite public APIs, graph runtime, layouts, interactions, WebGL rendering, and the browser platform
  - [Graph lifecycle](/en/docs/concepts/graph-lifecycle): Create, render, update, relayout, and destroy a G6Lite Graph instance
  - [Data model](/en/docs/concepts/data-model): Organize nodes, edges, combos, business fields, coordinates, and runtime states
- Configuration
  - [Data and Graph options](/en/docs/guides/data): Configure GraphData, elements, layouts, behaviors, themes, transforms, and plugins
  - [Nodes](/en/docs/guides/node): Configure node types, functional styles, labels, and state styles
  - [Edges](/en/docs/guides/edge): Configure line, arc, curve, polyline, arrows, labels, and state styles
  - [Labels and icons](/en/docs/guides/label): Configure node labels, edge labels, icons, placement, rotation, and collision behavior
  - [Combos](/en/docs/guides/combo): Group nodes with nested, collapsible, draggable combo containers
  - [Themes](/en/docs/guides/theme): Use light and dark presets or override G6Lite theme tokens
  - [Layout configuration](/en/docs/guides/layout): Choose built-in layouts, configure workers, and rerun layout at runtime
  - [Interaction configuration](/en/docs/guides/interactions): Combine viewport, element, selection, highlight, and tooltip behaviors
  - [Custom Behavior](/en/docs/guides/custom-behavior): Build reusable interactions with typed options, GraphEventMap, and extensionFactory
  - [Events](/en/docs/guides/events): Listen to public events with GraphEventMap and graph.on, graph.off, and graph.once
  - [Tooltip configuration](/en/docs/guides/tooltip): Show node and edge information with the built-in tooltip behavior
  - [Parallel and self-loop edges](/en/docs/guides/parallel-edges): Separate multiple edges that share endpoints and render self-loops clearly
  - [Extension system](/en/docs/guides/extensions): Extend nodes, edges, labels, layouts, behaviors, transforms, decorations, and plugins
  - [Custom nodes](/en/docs/guides/custom-node): Register functional NodeExtension implementations through the public package API
  - [Custom label renderers](/en/docs/guides/custom-label-renderer): Customize label measurement and drawing while reusing G6Lite placement and scheduling
- API reference
  - [API reference](/en/docs/api): Generated by TypeDoc from the public API in src/index.ts
- Examples
  - [Graph examples](/en/docs/examples): Browse and run website examples organized by G6Lite public capabilities
  - [Minimal graph](/en/docs/examples/basic): Render a zoomable and draggable graph with minimal configuration
  - [Default themes and interaction states](/en/docs/examples/default-theme): Inspect light and dark presets together with built-in node and edge states
  - [Node and edge mutations](/en/docs/examples/data-mutations): Demonstrate individual and batch node and edge additions, updates, and removals
  - [Queries, batch states, and visibility](/en/docs/examples/queries-and-states): Inspect elements, adjacency, and states while controlling batch states and visibility
  - [Replace graph data](/en/docs/examples/set-data): Replace the whole graph with setData, then switch layouts.
  - [Search and focus](/en/docs/examples/search-focus): Search nodes by name, highlight matches, and move the viewport to them.
  - [Data-driven node styles](/en/docs/examples/node-style): Map business fields to node colors, sizes, and highlight interactions
  - [Node shapes](/en/docs/examples/shapes): Compare circle and rectangle nodes side by side.
  - [Node stroke and radius](/en/docs/examples/node-border): Adjust stroke, width, and rectangle corner radius.
  - [Edge arrow directions](/en/docs/examples/edge-arrows): Compare no-arrow, one-way, bidirectional, and wide-arrow edges
  - [Edge types](/en/docs/examples/edge-types): Show line, dashed, arc, and cubic edges.
  - [Edge colors](/en/docs/examples/edge-colors): Map edge colors from a business category.
  - [Edge states and weight](/en/docs/examples/edge-states): Map edge width from weight and inspect edge state styles.
  - [Thin-edge hit area](/en/docs/examples/edge-hit-area): Keep a thin stroke while expanding the pick area of lines, curves, and loops.
  - [Parallel and reverse edges](/en/docs/examples/parallel-edges): Separate same-direction parallel edges, reverse edges, and single edges automatically
  - [Self-loop edges](/en/docs/examples/edge-loops): Show one self-loop and several nested loops on a node.
  - [Label placement and icons](/en/docs/examples/labels): Show node labels, edge labels, and icons, and change their placement at runtime.
  - [Label rendering policy](/en/docs/examples/label-rendering-options): Compare fixed size, low-zoom drawing, and collision hiding.
  - [Polyline orthogonal routing](/en/docs/examples/polyline-routing): Connect a left-to-right flow with rounded orthogonal polylines.
  - [Combo containers](/en/docs/examples/combo): Explore nested groups, collapse and expand, runtime regrouping, and data export
  - [Common layout switching](/en/docs/examples/layouts): Switch between circular, force, grid, and dagre with the same data
  - [More built-in layouts](/en/docs/examples/layout-gallery): Compare radial, concentric, ForceAtlas2, fruchterman, MDS, and random layouts
  - [Flowchart](/en/docs/examples/flowchart): Draw a decision flow with a hierarchical layout and polyline edges.
  - [Indented tree](/en/docs/examples/indented-tree): Show a directory with the indented layout.
  - [Worker layout](/en/docs/examples/layout-worker): Run force layout in a Web Worker so the main thread stays responsive.
  - [Radial tree](/en/docs/examples/radial-tree): Place a topic tree around a center node with the radial layout.
  - [Call graph](/en/docs/examples/dependency-graph): Show service calls with a left-to-right hierarchical layout.
  - [Character relationship network](/en/docs/examples/relationship): Explore character connections with force layout and relationship labels
  - [Organization chart](/en/docs/examples/org-chart): Show organization and team reporting relationships with hierarchical layout
  - [Mind map](/en/docs/examples/mindmap): Organize knowledge with two-sided branches around a central topic
  - [Fishbone diagram](/en/docs/examples/fishbone): Organize a problem, categories, and causes into a fishbone structure
  - [Tooltip](/en/docs/examples/tooltip): Show custom business information while hovering nodes or edges
  - [Hover highlight](/en/docs/examples/hover): Highlight related elements on hover and dim the rest.
  - [One-hop highlight](/en/docs/examples/neighbor-highlight): Highlight a node with its neighbors, or an edge with its endpoints.
  - [Click, brush, and lasso selection](/en/docs/examples/selection-behaviors): Compare click, brush, and lasso selection behaviors in one example
  - [Drag nodes and combos](/en/docs/examples/drag-node): Drag a node, or drag a combo background to move its nodes.
  - [Drag edge endpoints](/en/docs/examples/drag-edge): Drag an edge endpoint onto another node to reconnect it.
  - [Event log](/en/docs/examples/event-log): Inspect the public events emitted by click, drag, and selection.
  - [Context menu](/en/docs/examples/context-menu): Open a node context menu to focus or highlight it.
  - [Viewport and coordinate conversion](/en/docs/examples/viewport-controls): Validate camera, fit, zoom, focus, resize, and screen/graph coordinate conversion
  - [Zoom range and sensitivity](/en/docs/examples/zoom-options): Limit wheel zoom with sensitivity, minimum zoom, and maximum zoom.
  - [Extension system showcase](/en/docs/examples/extension-system): Combine decoration, edge, layout, transform, behavior, and plugin extensions
  - [Breathing node](/en/docs/examples/breathing-node): Show selected and highlight states with a custom node animation.
  - [Custom label renderer](/en/docs/examples/custom-label-renderer): Share one custom label renderer between nodes and edges.
  - [Custom nodes and explicit edge IDs](/en/docs/examples/custom-node-extension): Register a custom node and use explicit edge IDs with combo state.
  - [Register a custom behavior](/en/docs/examples/custom-behavior): Register a behavior that selects a clicked node and clears selection on the canvas.
  - [Custom layout](/en/docs/examples/custom-layout): Register a layout extension that places nodes in two rows.
  - [Node badges](/en/docs/examples/decoration-badges): Stack count, status, and text badges on a node boundary.
  - [AI Papers large relationship graph](/en/docs/examples/real-dataset): Validate large-graph rendering and interaction with a real paper citation network
  - [200 nodes](/en/docs/examples/large): Inspect rendering and interaction on a 200-node graph.
  - [5,000 labeled nodes](/en/docs/examples/large-labeled): Draw canvas labels on a 5,000-node graph.
- Technical metrics
  - [Performance metrics](/en/docs/metrics/performance): Reproduce G6Lite Node and browser benchmarks with explicit environments and result boundaries
  - [Performance tuning](/en/docs/metrics/performance-tuning): Measure and optimize first render, layout, updates, labels, and viewport interaction
  - [Bundle size](/en/docs/metrics/bundle-size): Reproduce the size-limit measurement and enforce the 120 kB brotli budget
- Compatibility
  - [Compatibility overview](/en/docs/compatibility): Browser, runtime, public API stability, and G6 v5 migration boundaries
  - [Browsers and runtime environment](/en/docs/compatibility/browser): WebGL, ESM, browser support, SSR boundaries, and known runtime constraints
  - [API stability and release boundary](/en/docs/compatibility/api-stability): Public package entry points, deprecated compatibility APIs, and experimental capabilities
  - [Graph library comparison](/en/docs/compatibility/library-comparison): Compare G6Lite, G6 v5, sigma.js, and Cytoscape.js across rendering, layout, elements, interaction, extensions, algorithms, and runtimes
  - [Migrate from G6 v5](/en/docs/compatibility/g6-v5-migration): Migrate configuration, data, Behaviors, events, Graph APIs, and extensions from G6 v5 to G6Lite
- [FAQ](/en/docs/faq): Selection, performance, compatibility, SSR, TypeScript, and combo questions
- [Changelog](/en/docs/changelog): Important G6Lite beta changes and migration boundaries
